notes.notes:

Check out our last game mode where our rollers will have to survive finishing as maps as possible in a single game.

Leaderboard has been adapted to Steam in order to find out who is the best Spheria roller. 

20 maps are waiting for you to finish them all and became the new SurviBall!

Have fun!

notes.title: Spring Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello Rollers! 
We've been working on redesign Spheria experience focusing on making the game more competitive between users, we have a secret plan to accomplish that. This new update 2.0 is our first step with that purpose in mind. 

Latest changes:
- Redesigned in-game interface
Players can now have more information about the map they are playing like last best local time as well as the best online player on that map.
http://daydreamsoftware.es/spheria/imgs/Screenshots-v2/ScreenshotNewUI.jpg

- New Turbo Boost for every ball.
Now players can activate limited velocity boost which is reloaded with every time an engine is activated.
http://daydreamsoftware.es/spheria/imgs/Screenshots-v2/Turbo3-Opt.gif

- Improved controls
Map preview in game has been replaced by zoom buttons allowing players to zoom in and out without stop rolling.
Turbo activation has been adapted for all supported controls
http://daydreamsoftware.es/spheria/imgs/Screenshots-v2/ScreenshotNewUI3.jpg

- Refined user experience
We have added more animations and new effects to bring the players the Spheria experience as immersive as possible.
Bug fixes and parameters recalibration.


Keep updated! All these changes will be uploaded to the game on the next few days.

Try it out and break the scores with this new update! ːsteammockingː
